question: How many days does February have in a leap year?
solution: February has 1 extra day in a leap year. A common-year February has 28 days, so a leap-year February has \(28+1=29\) days. The answer is A.

nodes.description: Add and subtract within 20, demonstrating fluency for addition and subtraction within 10.
